title: Monthly revenue and service mix
summary: This synthetic example demonstrates a reusable report bundle. October has the highest revenue among the four supplied months; the figures do not describe a real business.
findings: Revenue increases from 12,000 USD in July to 14,850 USD in October, with a decline in September.
caveats: Four monthly observations do not establish a forecast or a causal explanation.
